hypothesis: W-R20 correctly identified every paired local swap on new generator families, but both its top-two and single-channel models may exploit full observation support. Erase a preregistered subset of non-swapped candidate timepoints before forming matched positive/negative pairs and measure whether the existing frozen learned features survive.
freeze: The exact occlusion positions, counts 0/2/4/6, all generator families and thresholds are frozen before first use. Do not change swap sites or masks when results arrive.
training: Reuse only W-R19 frozen development seeds160..175, exactly original 1728 paired examples per fixed 16-weight+bias model, 32 epochs, LR0.1, four W-R19 feature arms. No adaptation/retraining to occlusions, new generator families or W-R20 heldout.
mask_rule: After generating the candidate, replace entire four-channel row with exact (0,0,0,0) for the first N tick indices in the fixed mask order; keep index 0 and both swapped row positions t=11,12 and t=13,14 untouched. Apply negative swap after mask, ensuring matched positive/negative candidate anchors and multisets.
outcome: ROBUST_OCCLUSION if mean_top_two_64 >=0.80 accuracy in EVERY 12 heldout cells at occlusion counts4/6 and exceeds first_channel_max pooled accuracy on those cells by >=0.05. PARTIAL if mean_top_two_64 improves over first_channel_max by >=0.03 pooled for occlusion4/6 without meeting strict threshold. NEGATIVE otherwise. Full confusion for each seed/cell/model, including perfect zero-occlusion controls.
controls: Distinct heldout seeds from W-R19/W-R20 and all previous experiments
All negative pairs swap untouched observable rows, so no identical positive/negative labels
All model widths, weights, epochs identical to frozen W-R19 original development
No new sensors, time budget outside explicit factorial evaluation, post-result tuning, or replay
Immutable source/prereg Git blobs, original artifact prior to final full Go regression
claim_limit: Synthetic observation-erasure robustness of fixed-width paired temporal classifiers; no natural-language understanding.
